title: A Lantern for the Orchard
author: Ulyana Coldharbour
blurb: Ines Halloran, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
